author: XtraMajestical
body:
-https://youtu.be/q_OqbsKG6Do
1: Players head goes to the left(towards camera) then locks back on player, suggesting a toggle aim button in use
2: The player is placing blocks to block up the enterance, then soon as the blue player enters the range of FF, he hits them due to the FF, and he isnt even looking at them when he hits them. Indicating this is accidental as the player continues to place blocks after.
3: This one is not very obvious but as you can see he hits the red player multiple times while approaching, and he should of realised after 1 hit the player is not on their team. (Vague)
4: In the video this isnt explained very well, but, the player in question approaches a fight, but without hitting the blue player when entering the fight, his head is locked onto the red player on his team infront which can be a sign of KA/Aimbot
5: Watch the players head exactly follow the movements of the blue team player, "dev_revs", and not missing a hit
6: Vague but either aimbot locking onto the team player behind him or KA
6B(I missed the number on video- 2:37+): Watch how as the blue players falls in line with the blocks of the bridge, they get hit despite his head is still aiming straight forward
7: Kill aura with reach used, as he hits the player running away from 4+ blocks away, also towards the end when there is a clear button they must press to aim, as his aim slides off to each side, and the locks and hits (3:00,3:01,3:02) each button toggle
8: Obvious kill aura bind to the wrong player :/ - Hits them loads and locks aim on them
9: Players head is looking staight forward and hits player as they fall in the void
10: Enters KA range and autolocks and hits, as it is a very instant reaction
11: Accidental KA toggle, or push to aim button pressed
12: Very susptious KB and reach

Rest of video is just randomly black

title: Kysumi Report

replies.author: Goodnighht
replies.body:
1. Good enough aim to combo someone, not perfect, I do this all the time.
2. Teammate behind the blue person hit him. 
3. You've never attacked your team, not get a hit, think it's lag and keep swinging?
4. Lag and his teammate died instantly after.
5. Not hard to tell where he was about to be going, he had to jump and that was one of only a few blocks he could have jumped to.
6. Lag, his head did go down almost instantly after that hit. Minecraft doesn't load head swings like that instantly, especially if he's lagging (Which he clearly is a little bit)
7. Again, bad aim, no obvious sign of reach or KA. There's only one hit that is a big fishy and it's the second hit, which that could be possible with a small lag spike for either of the players.
8. Attacking his teammate again, never done that?
9.His head does move, just delayed, like explained above.
10. He had plenty of time to aim, jump, and swing. He would have seen him long before he attacked.
11. Got scared by his teammate. His aim was off anyway.
12. Only thing would be possible anti-kb or kb reducer, but even then sometimes kb is non exsistant. I've been getting that sometimes on servers, where I get hit but I don't go anywhere. No idea why, but it happens. 

Not hacking imo

replies.author: Skquid
replies.body:
I Have to agree with what Micquisha said above for the teammates, he was heading the same way the enemy was in 8, and could've mistakenly thought that he was on their team. Ive attacked my teammate too, forgetting what team I am on. The others points made above do make sense, so I'm going to have to agree with not hacking on this one.


Edit: If he was using Kill Aura, that could explain the things he did, but being able to validly explain what happened with common phenomenons can't prove a hacker.

replies.author: Goodnighht
replies.body: Not necessarily. If you played team games a lot you would get used to looking for your own team and knowing who to attack and who not to attack. If you played only solo UHC or solo SG for 4-5 years, it would an immediate reaction to attack everyone you see. For most people on Avicus, we are used to team games, and it's normal to know who your team is. It may not be for him, so for him it happens a lot that he would attack his own team. He's used to everyone being an enemy.
